text:
ada_partner: Quick sync w/ LangChain & LlamaIndex Thurs 10am PT. Goal: finalize connector spec + check gateway onboarding + marketplace packaging. Who's in? @sam_g @maria_pm

sam_g: I'll join. Can we add auth, batching, streaming, metrics, and fallback model policy to the checklist?

maria_pm: Yes — also co-marketing timeline. We need legal signoff for logo use before any joint announcement.

lee_eng: For the connector spec I sketched a minimal manifest we can use for both LC/LI. Thoughts?

lee_eng: ```yaml
connector:
  name: redwood-llamaindex
  auth: api_key
  endpoints:
    - /embed
    - /query
  supports_streaming: true
  batching: auto
  metrics: [latency_ms, tokens_out, errors]
  fallback_model: redwood-small-v1
```

kunal_infra: That manifest looks fine. For gateway onboarding we need to validate CORS + signed JWT flow for private deployments. Can we confirm dev-sandbox will have those flows enabled?

ada_partner: @kunal_infra good call — add the sandbox validation to the agenda. Also want to confirm LlamaIndex team ok with our batching semantics (auto == server-managed batching).

sam_g: I can demo how auto batching interacts with streaming — usually we flush prefixes within 200ms window, but show both modes.

maria_pm: Marketing ask: if partners are comfortable, aim for a co-announcement week after integration test passes. Need a 2-week buffer for copy + approvals.

marketing_sj: noted. I'll draft joint blog outline + social plan. Can we commit to a list of partner quotes by EOD Tuesday?

ada_partner: I'll ping contact at LangChain and LlamaIndex right after this thread. Action items:
- lee_eng: finalize manifest and post PR to connectors repo (due Wed)
- kunal_infra: enable sandbox flows + CORS test (due Thu morning)
- sam_g: prepare demo for batching/streaming (Thu sync)
- marketing_sj & maria_pm: draft co-announcement timeline + partner quote template (due Tue EOD)

devex_bot: Reminder: connectors repo has CI that runs integration tests on PRs. Tag @devex if you need infra.

sam_g: One more ask — can we include an optional example for orchestration tools (Prefect/Argo) to show how to call the connector from workflows? I can add a short snippet.

lee_eng: Good idea. I'll add a tiny Prefect example in the PR docs.

maria_pm: If everything aligns, we'll route the announcement through partner comms and Redwood newsroom. Will update calendar invite after LangChain confirms. :thumbsup:

ada_partner: Perfect. Thanks everyone — see you Thu 10am PT.
